However, because A15 is repeated for every account in the district, the AVG will be weighted by the number of accounts in each district. The question asks for 'average number of crimes... in regions', which implies an unweighted average of the regional values. The current SQL computes a weighted average (weighted by account count). To compute the unweighted average of regional crime counts, we should first get distinct districts meeting the criteria, then average their A15 values.
